run_tokenize_thai_stdin: run the script to tokenize Thai text from stdin using pythainlp word_tokenize
run_tokenize_thai_file: run the script to tokenize Thai text from a file by piping it into stdin
create_thai_tokenizer_script: create a script that tokenizes Thai text line by line using pythainlp word_tokenize
refactor_tokenize_thai_output: refactor the tokenize_thai script to write tokenized output to a file instead of stdout
review_tokenize_thai_script: review the tokenize_thai script that uses pythainlp to tokenize Thai text from stdin
